C1647.title: Fully On-Chain Game Open Economies Face Bot Manipulation and Speculative Risks
C1647.summary: An analysis from November 2023 highlights that the permissionless nature of fully on-chain games opens the door for bots. Automated programs can grant players unfair advantages or manipulate in-game economies, undermining fairness and integrity.
